menuPanel.buttonsPerRowGlobal: Buttons per row (main menu & all sub-menus)
menuPanel.orScript: OR: Script (JS adapter) for the reply text
menuPanel.imageDatapointOptional: Image datapoint (optional, text becomes the caption)
menuPanel.ackOnly: Only when value is confirmed (ack: true)
menuPanel.imageInsteadOfText: Image datapoint (instead of/in addition to text)
menuPanel.httpRequest: HTTP request (instead of/in addition to script)
menuPanel.menuKeyHint1: Technical name (used for nextMenu/parent). Main entry must be exactly
menuPanel.menuKeyHint2: . Empty = internal ID is used (not recommended).
menuPanel.bundlingHint: Applies to all areas. Everything EXCEPT these types gets collected and bundled into one message. Empty = default "warn,error" stay immediate, rest gets bundled.
menuPanel.boolHint2: placeholders. Boolean values (true/false) show this text automatically.
menuPanel.dateHint2: placeholders. Auto-detects date vs. date+time. Building blocks: DD, MM, YYYY, HH, mm, ss.
menuPanel.replyTextHint1: Empty = title only, as before. Set = this text shows on open -
menuPanel.replyTextHint2: is replaced with the current value. Math works too:
menuPanel.imageReplyHint: Set = image instead of text, with reply text/title as caption. Datapoint value: URL, file path or Base64.
menuPanel.backMainHint: Creates both buttons side by side - always stay paired together when saving.
menuPanel.percentHint: Buttons across a percent range (default 0-100%, step adjustable, e.g. for blinds). Tap writes value directly, active value marked live with ✅.
menuPanel.numberRangeHint: Like percent-steps, but with free min/max/step and a unit (e.g. 16-28°C for heating). Descending also possible.
menuPanel.eventTriggerHint: Opens this menu automatically for all authorized users once the datapoint reaches this value. Empty = no auto-open. Comparison like status icons: exact text or operator ("<25", ">=10").
menuPanel.toggleHint: Set = button reads the current value, writes back the opposite - no script/command needed.
menuPanel.fixedValueHint: Set = button ALWAYS writes this exact value (e.g. mode presets) - no script/command needed.
menuPanel.askValueHint: Set = button asks for a value, your next message is written directly - no script/command needed.
menuPanel.statusAbhaengigExtra: For status-dependent: only applies if the matching rule above has NO own target datapoint - otherwise the rule takes priority.
menuPanel.scriptHint1: Short name is enough (folder comes from adapter config, default "Telegram") - or full ID
menuPanel.scriptHint3: in this script. Script just needs:
menuPanel.httpBodyHint1: Sent as-is to Telegram once set (no checkbox needed).
menuPanel.httpBodyHint2: is replaced with the current state value when sending.
menuPanel.httpBodyHintStatus: {status} is replaced with the matching rule's status text.
menuPanel.httpBodyHintDatapoint: With datapoint set: custom message only replaces the confirmation, the datapoint still gets switched.
menuPanel.httpBodyHintScript: With script set: the script's reply takes priority over this message.
menuPanel.httpConfirmHint: Set = button fires this HTTP request instead of/in addition to the script. Confirmation shows HTTP status - "message" above can use {status}/{response} (truncated to 300 chars).
toolbar.resetDoneMsg: Reset done - {n} menu(s) removed, canvas cleared. Reopen the tab for a clean demo graph, or keep building here - save only afterwards.
toolbar.noMainMenuWarning: No menu with key "main" found - /start would lead nowhere. Check the menu key on the main-menu node.
canvas.removeConnectionHint: Remove this connection without deleting the connected nodes.
canvas.usageHint: Tap a node to edit, tap a connection to delete. Drag the dot on the edge to connect.
menuPanel.multiStatusHint: Multi-status switch: each status value gets its own emoji, label and write target - e.g. status "off" → button "▶️ Start", status "running" → button "⏹ Stop", each with its own target.
autoMenu.usersHint: One entry per registered user, auto-generated as soon as someone contacts the bot. Each entry leads to a generic detail view with role/rights toggles - no need to draw it individually.
autoMenu.notifyHint: One toggle per area+type, auto-generated. Only shows areas the user already has rights for.
menuPanel.liveLoadHint: Loaded automatically on open (types, labels, override). "Load live" refreshes and replaces the list here completely. Removed rows are also deleted on the adapter when saving.
autoMenu.areaLabelPlaceholder: Display name for the area, e.g. Weather
autoMenu.typeLabelsPlaceholder: Type display names, in type order: PriceChange,Information
menuPanel.scriptOverridesHint: With both set: the script is called on open, its reply overrides title/reply text (e.g. for formatting placeholders can't do). Takes priority over "reply text" above. Buttons in THIS menu are kept regardless - normal navigation via "nextMenu" is enough, no need for a button-script call with "menuKey" anymore.
menuPanel.confirmValueHint: ONLY for the confirmation AFTER a value is set (then jumps back to the parent menu) - unlike "reply text" above, which applies when simply opening this menu. {value} and {unit} are replaced by the value/unit just set. Empty = default "✅ 60% set.".
menuPanel.imageCommandHint: Set = button sends an image. Datapoint value can be a URL, file path or Base64 (also with "data:image/..." prefix). If "Script" is also set, its reply becomes the caption (e.g. dynamic status text) - otherwise "Message" if set. Always both together in one message, never either/or.
menuPanel.eventTriggerHintShort: Opens this menu automatically for all authorized users once the datapoint reaches this value. Empty = no auto-open.
menuPanel.statusLabelPlaceholder: Label for this status, e.g. AC off
menuPanel.percentHintVariant: Creates a row of buttons across the value range (e.g. 0%, 10%, ..., 100%). Tap writes the value directly, the currently active value is marked live with ✅.
demo.scriptBridgeTitle: Script bridge test (needs its own test script)
tab.socketTimeout: Socket connection to ioBroker: timeout on start.
tab.socketNoConnect: Socket connection to ioBroker: no connection established.
tab.confirmDeleteAll: Really delete ALL menus from the adapter? This also removes accumulated old test leftovers. Do not forget to save again afterwards.
tab.areasLoadedMsg: {n} area(s) loaded from adapter (complete, replaces local list)
